raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Plant-Based Muscle Gain Program"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Muscle hypertrophy with plant-based nutrition target 150g protein/day"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper/Push focus":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower/Quads Focus":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          leg_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          leg_extension 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 50m "Back/Arms Focus":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper/Push progression":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower/Glutes & Hamstrings":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 50m "Back/Arms Variation":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x5..8 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          skull_crusher 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 3:
      REPEAT WEEK 2 with small load progression (increase by ~2.5–5% or add 1 rep where possible)
    WEEK 4:
      DELoad: reduce volume by ~40% but keep movements

  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Hypertrophy Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower/Volume Emphasis":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          leg_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 55m "Back/Arms":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 6:
      REPEAT WEEK 5 with progression
    WEEK 7:
      DOWNSHIFT to Phase 3 progression? (continue progression)
    WEEK 8:
      DELoad 40%

  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Hypertrophy Mix":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower/Glutes Focus":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          sumo_squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 60m "Back/Arms Intensity":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x5..8 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          skull_crusher 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 10:
      REPEAT WEEK 9 with progression
    WEEK 11:
      PEAK WEEK: slightly higher intensities, similar volume
    WEEK 12:
      TAPER: reduce volume by 40% and maintain intensity; test 1RM only if planned

NUTRITION PLAN (plant-based target 150g protein/day)
- Daily protein target: 150g
- Split across 4–6 meals/s — example distribution: 30g, 25g, 35g, 20g, 25g, 20g
- Protein sources (plant-based, complete proteins emphasized):
  - legumes (lentils, chickpeas, beans)
  - soy products (tofu, tempeh, edamame)
  - seitan (gluten)
  - quinoa, buckwheat, amaranth
  - tempeh, edamame, soy milk/yogurt (calculated into meals)
  - protein powders (pea, rice, hemp, or blends) to reach targets
- Meal timing:
  - 4–6 meals per day; aim within 1–3 hours post-workout for a bolus protein
- Calorie target: aim for slight surplus to gain muscle; adjust per bodyweight and progression
- Hydration: 2.5–3.5 liters water/day
- Supplements (optional, discuss with client):
  - Vitamin B12
  - Vitamin D if insufficient sun
  - Omega-3 (algal oil)
  - Calcium if intake is low
  - Creatine monohydrate (3–5g/day) supports strength/muscle gain
- Monitoring:
  - track protein grams via app; adjust portions to hit 150g
  - weight and progress photos every 4 weeks

Notes:
- All exercises use canonical names from the vocabulary.
- Rest periods and RPE guidance are included.
- Cardio activities limited to warmups/cooldowns or optional steady sessions; use running, cycling, rowing as listed. 
- Ensure form and gradually increase weights weekly to drive progression.
- Nutrition plan should be aligned with dietary preferences; consider meal prep to hit protein target.
